next.reason: 1985: compiling a program with COPY is logically equivalent to processing all COPY statements before the resultant program. 2023 keeps that order: §2023:7.2.1 (uncatalogued prose) puts COPY incorporation in the text-manipulation stage that produces the structured compilation group used by the compilation stage; §2023:7.2.3.4 GR6 replaces the COPY statement by library text; §2023:7.2.3.4 GR8 places REPLACING 'during creation of the structured compilation group'. Same meaning for a 1985 program.
